title: Yolk
author: Mary H.K. Choi
current_text: Frisco Independent School District in Texas banned Yolk from libraries and classrooms in November 2022. Clay County School District in Florida banned Yolk from libraries and classrooms following a formal challenge in September 2022. Volusia County Schools in Florida banned Yolk from libraries and classrooms in June 2023. Beaufort County School District in South Carolina banned Yolk pending investigation following an informal challenge in October 2022. Escambia County Public Schools in Florida banned Yolk pending investigation following a formal challenge in December 2022, and St. John's County School District in Florida banned it pending investigation in January 2023.
